描述_EN: in the back is a movable panel. in daoism, a deity represents a historical figure who was worshipped in local temples after death because of good deeds. the standing daoist deity is dressed in a long-sleeved robe, with his hands in front of his chest and probably originally held an object. the statue is painted and gilded with rich colours, apparently at various times.
描述_ZN: 后面是一个可移动的面板。 在道教中，一个神灵代表一个历史人物，他在死后因为善行而被当地寺庙所崇拜。 站立的道教神像身穿长袖长袍，双手放在胸前，最初可能拿着一个东西。 这尊雕像被涂上了丰富的色彩，显然是在不同时期。
